usage: eventboat [--json] trigger --config <job.yaml> [--parameters '{"from":"..."}']

flags:
  -config string
    	job pipeline configuration file
  -data-dir string
    	SQLite storage directory (default "data")
  -ephemeral
    	in-memory store (nothing persists)
  -json
    	machine-readable output for agents and CI (the global --json, also accepted here)
  -parameters string
    	JSON object of job parameters (e.g. backfill ranges)
